info.description: REST API for a task management application with JWT authentication.
info.title: Task Manager API

post.description: Authenticate with email and password, returns a JWT token

400.description: validation error

get.description: Retrieve information about the currently authenticated user

post.description: Create a new user account with a unique email and password

400.description: validation error or email already taken
validation error, not found, or access denied

delete.description: Only the project owner can delete an epic

400.description: not found, or not the owner
validation error, not found, or access denied

delete.description: Only the project owner can delete a milestone

400.description: not found, or not the owner

get.description: Get all projects the authenticated user is a member or owner of

post.description: Create a new project; the creator automatically becomes the project owner

400.description: validation error

get.description: Get project details; the requester must be a member of the project

400.description: invalid id or access denied

put.description: Update project details; only the project owner can perform this action

400.description: validation error, invalid id, or not the owner

delete.description: Delete a project; only the project owner can perform this action. Tasks in the project are unlinked, not deleted.

400.description: invalid id or not the owner
invalid id or access denied

post.description: Create a new epic within a project; requester must be a project member

400.description: validation error or access denied

get.description: Get all members of a project; the requester must be a member of the project

400.description: invalid id or access denied

post.description: Add a user to the project by email; only the project owner can perform this action

400.description: validation error, not the owner, user not found, or already a member

delete.description: Remove a member from the project; only the project owner can perform this action. The owner cannot be removed.

400.description: invalid id, not the owner, or attempting to remove the owner
invalid id or access denied

post.description: Create a new milestone within a project; requester must be a project member

400.description: validation error or access denied

get.description: Get a paginated list of tasks belonging to a project; the requester must be a member of the project

400.description: invalid id or access denied

get.description: Get a paginated list of tasks for the authenticated user, with optional filtering and sorting

post.description: Create a new task for the authenticated user, optionally attached to a project and assigned to a project member

400.description: validation error

put.description: Update a task owned by the authenticated user

400.description: validation error, invalid id, or not found/not owned

delete.description: Delete a task owned by the authenticated user

400.description: invalid id or not found/not owned

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and the JWT token.
